text_en: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had an Egyptian slave-girl whose name was Hagar,
text_cn: 亚巴郎的妻子撒辣依，没有给他生孩子，她有个埃及婢女，名叫哈加尔。

text_en: and Sarai said to Abram, “You see that the Lord has prevented me from bearing children; go in to my slave-girl; it may be that I shall obtain children by her. ” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
text_cn: 撒辣依就对亚巴郎说：“请看，上主既使我不能生育，你可去亲近我的婢女，或许我能由她得到孩子。”亚巴郎就听了撒辣依的话。

text_en: So, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her slave-girl, and gave her to her husband Abram as a wife.
text_cn: 亚巴郎住在客纳罕地十年后，亚巴郎的妻子撒辣依将自己的埃及婢女哈加尔，给了丈夫亚巴郎做妾。

text_en: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived; and when she saw that she had conceived, she looked with contempt on her mistress.
text_cn: 亚巴郎自从同哈加尔亲近，哈加尔就怀了孕；她见自己怀了孕；就看不起自己的主母。

text_en: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be on you! I gave my slave-girl to your embrace, and when she saw that she had conceived, she looked on me with contempt. May the Lord judge between you and me! ”
text_cn: 撒辣依对亚巴郎说：“我受羞辱是你的过错。我将我的婢女放在你怀里，她一见自己怀了孕，便看不起我。愿上主在我与你之间来判断！”

text_en: But Abram said to Sarai, “Your slave-girl is in your power; do to her as you please. ” Then Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she ran away from her.
text_cn: 亚巴郎对撒辣依说：“你的婢女是在你手中；你看怎样好，就怎样待她吧！”于是撒辣依就虐待她，她便由撒辣依面前逃跑了。

text_en: The angel of the Lord found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, the spring on the way to Shur.
text_cn: 上主的使者在旷野的水泉旁，即在往叔尔道上的水泉旁，遇见了她，

text_en: And he said, “Hagar, slave-girl of Sarai, where have you come from and where are you going? ” She said, “I am running away from my mistress Sarai. ”
text_cn: 对她说：“撒辣依的婢女哈加尔！你从哪里来，要往哪里去？”她答说：“我由我主母撒辣依那里逃出来的。”

text_en: The angel of the Lord said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit to her. ”
text_cn: 上主的使者对她说：“你要回到你主母那里，屈服在她手下。”

text_en: The angel of the Lord also said to her, “I will so greatly multiply your offspring that they cannot be counted for multitude. ”
text_cn: 上主的使者又对她说：“我要使你的后裔繁衍，多得不可胜数。”

text_en: And the angel of the Lord said to her, “Now you have conceived and shall bear a son; you shall call him Ishmael, for the Lord has given heed to your affliction.
text_cn: 上主的使者再对她说：“看，你已怀孕，要生个儿子；要给他起名叫依市玛耳，因为上主俯听了你的苦诉。”

text_en: He shall be a wild ass of a man, with his hand against everyone, and everyone’s hand against him; and he shall live at odds with all his kin. ”
text_cn: 他将来为人，像头野驴；他要反对众人，众人也要反对他；他要冲着自己的众兄弟支搭帐幕。”

text_en: So she named the Lord who spoke to her, “You are El-roi”; for she said, “Have I really seen God and remained alive after seeing him? ”
text_cn: 哈加尔遂给那对她说话的上主起名叫“你是看顾人的天主”，因为她说：“我不是也看见了那看顾人的天主吗？”

text_en: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; it lies between Kadesh and Bered.
text_cn: 为此她给那井起名叫拉海洛依井。这井是在卡德士与贝勒得之间。

text_en: Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram named his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
text_cn: 哈加尔给亚巴郎生了一个儿子，亚巴郎给哈加尔所生的儿子，起名叫依市玛耳。

text_en: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.
text_cn: 哈加尔给亚巴郎生依市玛耳时，亚巴郎已八十六岁。
